description: This course covers cryptographic algorithms such as AES, RSA, and ECC; secure socket layer (SSL) and transport layer security (TLS) protocols; intrusion detection systems (IDS) like Snort; network security concepts including firewalls, virtual private networks (VPN), and packet filtering; authentication mechanisms such as OAuth 2.0 and Kerberos; and secure programming practices using OpenSSL and CRYPTO libraries. It also includes the design and analysis of security protocols, the evaluation of vulnerabilities in networked systems, and the implementation of secure communication channels.

clos.text: Define cryptographic algorithms such as AES, RSA, and ECC, and their applications in secure communication.
Describe the architecture and operation of intrusion detection systems (IDS) like Snort and firewall technologies such as packet filtering and stateful inspection.
Explain the principles of secure authentication mechanisms, including OAuth 2.0 and Kerberos, and their role in network security.
Apply cryptographic libraries such as OpenSSL to implement secure data transmission protocols in programming projects.
Design and evaluate secure network architectures, including the implementation of SSL/TLS for secure web communication.
